01The Team

THE PEOPLEBEHIND THEFORM.

Six of the thirty minds who shape our work, from the first sketch to the final handover.

01 — Creative Director

Amara Okafor

Amara leads the studio's design vision. Trained in Lagos and London, she brings a love of colour, craft and storytelling to every project.

Connect with Amara

02 — Principal Architect

Mateo Alvarez

With 18 years in practice, Mateo shapes the structural and spatial thinking of our largest projects, from villas to workplaces.

Connect with Mateo

03 — Senior Architect

Yuki Tanaka

Yuki is a detail obsessive who turns bold concepts into elegant, buildable drawings and obsesses over how materials meet.

Connect with Yuki

04 — Interior Designer

Clara Whitfield

Clara composes rooms with colour, texture and light. Her interiors are known for their warmth and unexpected pairings.

Connect with Clara

05 — Design Strategist

Rafael Santos

Rafael connects client goals with design decisions, running workshops that turn vague ideas into clear, ambitious briefs.

Connect with Rafael

06 — Project Coordinator

Daniel Hart

Daniel keeps every project calm, on schedule and on budget, a quiet superpower that clients remember long after handover.

Connect with Daniel
